rows.title: Taken 2008, directed by Pierre Morel | Film review
rows.comment: Director Pierre Morel’s <strong>directing style is ruthlessly efficient
rows.verdict_le10: Director Pierre Morel’s <strong>directing style is ruthlessly efficient
rows.dek_lead: Director Pierre Morel’s directing style is ruthlessly efficient, but leaves no time to ponder the plot holes or the borderline racist portrayal of vicious Albanian gangsters and sleazy Arab businessmen.
